tail: Edit target: the supplied tall, flat spaceship UV texture crop. This is a precise-object-edit for a game texture, not a spaceship render. Keep the exact same flat orthographic crop, proportions, coordinates, weathered grey metal, chipped paint, red-and-white rising sun rays and sun disc, all actual straight panel seams, circular fasteners and surrounding lighting. REMOVE ALL large black Japanese characters in the upper middle (including the rightmost character which erroneously looks like raised mechanical hardware) and fill their footprints with the correct continuous worn red/white rays underneath. No letters, symbols or replacement text. The rising sun design itself must retain its exact shape, ray angles, placement, red colour and worn treatment. At the lower left and along the bottom of the sun, replace the incoherent black/white wave scribbles with a legible restrained black-and-off-white painted interpretation of Hokusai's Great Wave off Kanagawa: a distinct hooked curling wave crest on the left, claw-like foam fingers, elegantly nested curved thin water lines flowing along the bottom. Keep it confined to the existing wave footprint below/left of the disc, without obscuring any more of the red sun or expanding onto surrounding panels. Flat printed ink, matching existing modest paint wear, no raised or embossed relief, no blue colour, no frame or extra motifs. Preserve straight panel gaps passing through the artwork. All other pixels and forms remain as close as possible to the input. Output only the edited texture crop.
nose: Precise-object-edit: remove ALL THREE red Japanese characters from this tall flat spaceship texture crop. Reconstruct only the worn light silver-grey metal paint beneath their red strokes, matching the surrounding mottling, chipping, scratches and texture scale. Preserve every black panel line, bevel, rivet, exact border, framing, lighting and position. This is a UV texture crop that must align pixel-for-pixel with its source, so do not reframe, crop, add hardware, change perspective, move seams, change the metal colour or invent new symbols. Absolutely no text, characters, writing or new emblems anywhere. Output just the same texture crop with the red lettering removed, no captions or border.
